# Business Operations Agents

From supply chain monitoring to automated financial reporting, these agents handle the "heavy lifting" of corporate workflows.

## 🛠 Active Use Cases

### 📊 Automated Market Intelligence

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Description
An agent that scrapes competitor websites, news outlets, and financial reports to provide a daily summarized report of market trends, price changes, and strategic moves.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Implementation Example
A combination of **LangChain** and **Playwright** (or a scraping MCP server).
1.  **Input**: List of competitor URLs.
2.  **Process**: The agent visits the URLs, extracts text, and uses a Map-Reduce approach to summarize the most relevant findings.
3.  **Output**: A structured Slack notification or an entry in a Notion database.
:::

---

### 🧾 Intelligent Invoice Processing

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## Description
Automated extraction of data from heterogeneous invoice formats (PDFs, images) and reconciliation with purchase orders in an ERP system.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Implementation Example
Using **GPT-4o with Vision** to parse the invoice structure and an agentic loop to verify totals and tax calculations before pushing to an accounting API.
:::
